core_problem_solved: To provide higher-level, common utilities and adapters built on top of the core ASM API to simplify common bytecode transformation tasks.
key_features: Provides useful classes like `AdviceAdapter` for instrumenting method bodies
Includes `LocalVariablesSorter` and `Remapper` for complex class transformations
Simplifies common patterns, reducing the amount of raw bytecode manipulation needed
era_and_niche: A standard extension module for the ASM framework, used by developers who need to perform common bytecode transformations without dropping down to the lowest-level, most verbose API.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**. It is a current and standard part of the modular ASM ecosystem, meant to be used alongside the core `asm` artifact.
